goal_en: Rebuild the mandarin fish release from the new corpus: Chinese papers re-read with the current extraction (the Chinese text is the record, English is a checked rendering), then every open full-text paper the search found.
goal_zh: 用新语料重建鳜鱼版本：先用当前提取流程重读中文论文（中文原文为记录，英文为经核对的译文），再处理检索到的全部开放全文论文。

stages.note_en: Code: the quote must be on the page it cites
stages.note_zh: 代码核对：引文必须在所引页面上

stages.note_en: A different lab from the extractor
English shown only if every number survives
stages.note_zh: 所有数字都保留时才显示英文

stages.per: run (one call over the distinct intervention names)
stages.note_en: Groups names for the same practice; originals kept
stages.note_zh: 合并同一做法的不同名称；保留原名

stages.note_en: Validator rejects full text and unchecked claims
stages.note_zh: 校验器拒绝全文和未核对的论断

phases.name_zh: 中文论文，当前提取流程
phases.why_en: Replaces the current release, which was extracted with an older prompt: Chinese records, Chinese intervention names, English renderings with a number check, and no research methods (such as histopathology) counted as interventions.
phases.why_zh: 替换用旧版提示词提取的当前版本：中文记录、中文干预名称、经数字核对的英文译文，不再把研究方法（如组织病理学）当作干预措施。
commands: node pipeline/run.mjs --pages $OUT/pages-A.jsonl (text layer with every hand transcription swapped in) --out $OUT/A

phases.name_en: Every open full-text paper from the search
phases.name_zh: 检索到的全部开放全文论文
phases.why_en: The first run read 19 Chinese papers. This reads the 176 papers with open full text (170 English, 6 Chinese), so the release covers what English research says too.
phases.why_zh: 第一次运行读了 19 篇中文论文。这一阶段读取 176 篇有开放全文的论文（英文 170 篇，中文 6 篇），使版本也涵盖英文研究的内容。

gates.en: Stopped runs resume from their checkpoint; changed settings cannot mix into an old run
gates.zh: 中断后从检查点继续；设置改变后不会与旧结果混在一起

gates.en: No gold set yet, so recall is not measured. 20-30 hand-checked passages are needed
gates.zh: 尚无标准集，无法衡量召回率。需要 20-30 段人工核对的文本

gates.en: No expert has audited a sample, so no error rate can be published
gates.zh: 尚无专家抽样审核，无法公布错误率

to_build_first.en: prepare.mjs: join the corpus pages and trim reference lists
to_build_first.zh: prepare.mjs：合并语料页面并去掉参考文献

to_build_first.en: export --records: take each new paper's title, year, venue and DOI from the intake records, and accept several claim files
to_build_first.zh: export --records：从检索记录中读取每篇新论文的标题、年份、期刊和 DOI，并接受多个论断文件

outputs.en: A new release.json for the site
Every claim, verdict, rendering and model call uploaded to the dataset under mandarin-fish/run-2/
outputs.zh: 所有论断、核验结论、译文和模型调用记录上传到数据集的 mandarin-fish/run-2/

not_in_this_run_en: Chinese papers behind CNKI and Wanfang (needs a licence decision), papers without open full text (788 of the 964 in focus), and the reconcile and suggest stages.
not_in_this_run_zh: 知网和万方中的中文论文（需要授权决定）、没有开放全文的论文（重点范围 964 篇中的 788 篇），以及整合和建议阶段。
